findings.claim: Three surfaces disagree on filenames for both feature tasks: spec says apps/lib/chunk.mjs and csv.mjs, the visible tests import those paths, setup seeds <taskId>.mjs (the replace is a no-op), and the hidden grader imports <taskId>.mjs — a spec-faithful agent scores 0/N, and the seed-time RED for those tasks is a MODULE_NOT_FOUND, not a failing assertion
findings.proof: Run setup control chunk-generator; implement ONLY apps/lib/chunk.mjs exactly as spec and visible test direct; grade.mjs imports ./apps/lib/chunk-generator.mjs which is still the 'not implemented' stub — every test fails, 0/7, for spec-conformant visible-green work. The self-test is blind to it: it fabricates its own layout matching the hidden import by construction, never running setup or the visible suite. All four real feature runs had to invent undocumented alias files to bridge the seam (both arms' commits carry chunk.mjs/csv.mjs re-exports).
findings.dedupKey: three surfaces disagree on filenames for both feature tasks: spec says apps/lib/chunk.mjs and csv.mjs, the visible tests import those paths, setup seeds <taskid>.mjs (the replace is a no-op), and the hidden grader imports <taskid>.mjs — a spec-faithful agent scores 0/n, and the seed-time red for those tasks is a module_not_found, not a failing assertion

findings.claim: The grader fails open on absent/partial TAP: a 60s-timeout kill or an unresolvable node yields zero 'not ok' lines, tally returns failed=0, and the CLI exits 0 — a hung implementation is certified as an acceptance pass; module stdout shares the TAP channel so forged 'ok N' lines forge a score
findings.proof: An implementation with an import-time infinite loop: node --test emits TAP only for tests completed pre-hang; execFileSync kills at 60s; the catch path tallies partial (often empty) stdout; tally returns {failed:0}; grade exits 0 — the grader rewards hangs over failures. A module printing 'ok 1..8' and exit(0) at import forges 8/8. The total>0 guard lives only in the self-test, whose inputs cannot hang.
findings.dedupKey: the grader fails open on absent/partial tap: a 60s-timeout kill or an unresolvable node yields zero 'not ok' lines, tally returns failed=0, and the cli exits 0 — a hung implementation is certified as an acceptance pass; module stdout shares the tap channel so forged 'ok n' lines forge a score
